note: Per-seat models. This file is the only place model settings live;
the console can show it but cannot change it.
The key comes from ds_key.txt for DeepSeek seats; for any other provider
write "api_key" here, or name a "key_file", or an "api_key_env".
Seats not listed under "seats" use "default"; an empty default means the
model from ds_key.txt / the environment - i.e. the previous behaviour.

ds4.1-flash._comment: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, thinking at maximum effort (needs a big output budget: the thought is spent from it); key from ds_key.txt

gpt._comment: example for a future mixed game; inactive until a seat names it

kimi._comment: any OpenAI-shaped gateway: base_url is required
